synopsis: Liebherr’s wheel-loader automatic braking is described as reverse-only, within a broader off-road market offering reverse-only, low-speed or tag-dependent systems [f11393, f1239]. Its product descriptions focus on constrained rear and reverse interactions, not arbitrary forward and reverse movement across more than 100 site configurations [f1695]. Liebherr already logs warning events and GPS locations, providing a data path for proposed warning-fleet shadow-mode evaluation and braking validation [f1254, f1603]. However, no independent performance test or published validation method, validation duration or share of physical testing was found for the described Liebherr products; the glossary also reports no published weather limits or false-intervention rates [f1242, f1389, f11394].

relations.note: Both identify existing warning-event location logging as a data path for braking evaluation.
Specifies reverse-only operation for Liebherr wheel loaders within the broader constrained-system finding.
Reverse-only braking supports the finding that product scope concentrates on rear and reverse interactions.
Adds weather-limit and false-intervention disclosure gaps to the shared validation-method publication gap.
